VarianLionsFangLionsMawQuest.name: Lion's Maw
VarianLionsFangLionsMawQuest.description: Quest: Every time Lion's Fang hits a Hero, increase its damage by 7, up to 175. Reward: After hitting 25 Heroes, the Slow is increased to 50% and its duration is increased to 2 seconds.

VarianParryOverpower.name: Overpower
VarianParryOverpower.description: When Parry blocks a Hero's Basic Attack, Heroic Strike's cooldown is refreshed and the next one does 40% more damage.

VarianHighKingsQuestQuest.name: High King's Quest
VarianHighKingsQuestQuest.description: Quest: Hit 50 Heroes with Basic Attacks. Quest: Participate in 5 Hero Takedowns. Quest: Gather 15 Regeneration Globes. Reward: Completing a Quest grants 10 Base Attack Damage. Completing all 3 Quests grants an additional 30 Base Attack Damage.

VarianTaunt.name: Taunt
VarianTaunt.description: Silence a target Hero and force them to attack Varian for 1.25 seconds. Passive: Maximum Health and Health Regeneration increased by 40%.

VarianColossusSmash.name: Colossus Smash
VarianColossusSmash.description: Smash a target enemy, dealing 185 (+4% per level) damage and lowering their Armor by 25 for 3 seconds, causing them to take 25% increased damage. Passive: Base Attack Damage increased by 100%. Passive: Maximum Health and Health Regeneration reduced by 10%.

VarianTwinBladesOfFury.name: Twin Blades of Fury
VarianTwinBladesOfFury.description: Basic Attacks reduce Heroic Strike's cooldown by 9 seconds, and increase Varian's Movement Speed by 30% for 2 seconds. Passive: Attack Speed increased by 100%. Passive: Base Attack Damage reduced by 25%.

VarianLionsFangLionheart.name: Lionheart
VarianLionsFangLionheart.description: Increase Lion's Fang's healing from Heroes by 75%.

VarianSecondWind.name: Second Wind
VarianSecondWind.description: Basic Attacks heal Varian for 1% of his maximum Health. While below 50% Health, they also heal him for 50% of the damage dealt.

VarianVictoryRush.name: Victory Rush
VarianVictoryRush.description: Every 30 seconds, Varian's next Basic Attack will heal him for 350 (+4% per level) Health. When a nearby enemy Minion or Monster dies, the cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds.

VarianParryShieldWall.name: Shield Wall
VarianParryShieldWall.description: Parry grants Protected, preventing all incoming damage while active. Additionally, Parry's cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds, but it loses 1 charge.

VarianChargeWarbringer.name: Warbringer
VarianChargeWarbringer.description: Reduce Charge's cooldown by 8 seconds and Mana cost from 45 to 22. Additionally, Charge can be cast on allied Heroes.

VarianChargeJuggernaut.name: Juggernaut
VarianChargeJuggernaut.description: Charge deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 4% of their maximum Health.

VarianMortalStrike.name: Mortal Strike
VarianMortalStrike.description: Heroes hit by Heroic Strike receive 40% reduced healing for 4 seconds.

VarianShatteringThrow.name: Shattering Throw
VarianShatteringThrow.description: Activate to throw a sword at a target Hero that deals 50 (+4% per level) damage, and up to 1400 (+4% per level) bonus damage to their Shields. Passive: Basic Attacks against Heroes deal up to 200% bonus Physical Damage to Shields.

VarianBannerOfStormwind.name: Banner of Stormwind
VarianBannerOfStormwind.description: Activate to place a Banner that grants 25% increased Movement Speed to nearby allied Heroes. Lasts 12 seconds.

VarianBannerOfIronforge.name: Banner of Ironforge
VarianBannerOfIronforge.description: Activate to place a Banner that grants 20 Armor to nearby allied Heroes, reducing damage taken by 20%. Lasts 12 seconds.

VarianBannerOfDalaran.name: Banner of Dalaran
VarianBannerOfDalaran.description: Activate to place a Banner that grants 20% increased Spell Power to nearby allied Heroes. Lasts 12 seconds.

VarianTauntVigilance.name: Vigilance
VarianTauntVigilance.description: Being hit by a Hero Basic Attack reduces the cooldown of Taunt by 1 second.

VarianColossusSmashMasterAtArms.name: Master at Arms
VarianColossusSmashMasterAtArms.description: Colossus Smash affects all enemies near the target, and its cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds.

VarianTwinBladesOfFuryFrenzy.name: Frenzy
VarianTwinBladesOfFuryFrenzy.description: Twin Blades of Fury increases Heroic Strike damage by an additional 25%, and Basic Attacks increase his Movement Speed by an additional 10%.

VarianBannersGloryToTheAlliance.name: Glory to the Alliance
VarianBannersGloryToTheAlliance.description: Banner now also increases health regeneration and all healing received for nearby allied Heroes by 50%, and the cooldown is reduced by 50%.

VarianDemoralizingShout.name: Demoralizing Shout
VarianDemoralizingShout.description: Activate to demoralize nearby enemy Heroes, reducing damage they deal by 40% for 5 seconds.
